#### Questions

##### How much does the Bilibili video detail API cost?

One call costs $0.002 and returns one post. 1,000 lookups cost $2.00. Failed calls are not charged.

##### Can I pass a share link instead of an ID?

Yes. Put the link in url and okdata reads the ID from it. Short share links work too.

##### Do I need a Bilibili account, cookies or a QR login?

No. You send only your okdata API key. The data is public data from Bilibili; nothing is fetched with your own Bilibili account.

##### Am I charged when a call fails?

No. Every error response says charged: false, except a timeout, which says charged: null until the outcome is known. Resend with the same Idempotency-Key and you are never charged twice.

##### What if Bilibili does not show a field?

The field is null, and meta.unavailable names it with the reason: platform (the platform never shows it) or capability (we cannot fetch it yet).

- [Bilibili video comments](https://okdata.online/apis/bilibili/videos/comments/list/): $0.002 per call · about 20 comments per page
- [Bilibili popular board](https://okdata.online/apis/bilibili/trends/list/): $0.002 per call · about 50 board entries per page

### Bilibili video comments API

> Comments on a video, hottest or newest first.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/bilibili/videos/comments/list/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/bilibili/videos/comments/list`
- **ID**: `bilibili.videos.comments.list`
- **Price**: $0.002 per call · about 20 comments per page
- **Returns**: a page of about 20 comments (`data.items`, Comment objects)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Word of mouth

#### Price

One call costs $0.002 and returns one page of about 20 comments. Collecting 1,000 comments takes about 50 calls, $0.10 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  | The video ID. Give id or url. (e.g. `BV1xx411c7mD`) |
| `sort` | string: hot / latest | no | `hot` | Result order. |
| `cursor` | string | no |  | Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call. |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Comment](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/comment/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Comment ID. |
| `post_id` | string | ID of the post it is under. |
| `parent_id` | string \| null | The comment it replies to; null for top-level comments. |
| `text` | string | Comment text. |
| `published_at` | string | When it was posted, ISO 8601 in UTC. |
| `author` | AccountRef | Who wrote it. |
| `likes` | integer \| null | Likes on the comment. |
| `replies` | integer \| null | Replies under it. |
| `ip_location` | string \| null | Region label the platform shows next to the comment, if any. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL

```bash
curl -G "https://api.okdata.online/v1/bilibili/videos/comments/list" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'id=BV1xx411c7mD'
```

##### Python

```python
import os
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    "https://api.okdata.online/v1/bilibili/videos/comments/list",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OKDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    params={"id": "BV1xx411c7mD"},
    timeout=60,
)
body = resp.json()
if body["code"] != "ok":
    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")

for row in body["data"]["items"]:
    print(row["likes"], row["text"])
print("cost: $" + body["meta"]["billing"]["amount"])
```

##### TypeScript

```ts

  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.OKDATA_API_KEY}`,
  },
});
const body = await res.json();
if (body.code !== 'ok') throw new Error(`${body.code}: ${body.message}`);

for (const row of body.data.items) {
  console.log(row.likes, row.text);
}
console.log('cost: $' + body.meta.billing.amount);
```

### Bilibili popular board API

> The current popular videos board.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/bilibili/trends/list/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/bilibili/trends/list`
- **ID**: `bilibili.trends.list`
- **Price**: $0.002 per call · about 50 board entries per page
- **Returns**: a page of about 50 board entries (`data.items`, Trend objects)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Trend research

#### Price

One call costs $0.002 and returns one page of about 50 board entries. Collecting 1,000 board entries takes about 20 calls, $0.04 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | string | no |  | Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call. |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Trend](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/trend/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `rank` | integer | Position on the board, 1 is the top. |
| `name` | string | The topic or search term. |
| `heat` | number \| null | The heat score the platform shows; scales differ by platform. |
| `url` | string \| null | Link to the topic page, if there is one. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL

```bash
curl "https://api.okdata.online/v1/bilibili/trends/list" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY"
```

##### Python

```python
import os
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    "https://api.okdata.online/v1/bilibili/trends/list",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OKDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    params={},
    timeout=60,
)
body = resp.json()
if body["code"] != "ok":
    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")

for row in body["data"]["items"]:
    print(row["rank"], row["name"], row["heat"])
print("cost: $" + body["meta"]["billing"]["amount"])
```

##### TypeScript

```ts

  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.OKDATA_API_KEY}`,
  },
});
const body = await res.json();
if (body.code !== 'ok') throw new Error(`${body.code}: ${body.message}`);

for (const row of body.data.items) {
  console.log(row.rank, row.name, row.heat);
}
console.log('cost: $' + body.meta.billing.amount);
```

### Weibo post search API

> Posts matching keywords, latest or hot, with reposts, comments and likes.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/weibo/posts/search/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/weibo/posts/search`
- **ID**: `weibo.posts.search`
- **Price**: $0.002 per call · about 10 posts per page
- **Returns**: a page of about 10 posts (`data.items`, Post objects)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Word of mouth, Trend research

#### Price

One call costs $0.002 and returns one page of about 10 posts. Collecting 1,000 posts takes about 100 calls, $0.20 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  | Keywords, as a person would type them into the platform search box. (e.g. `新品发布`) |
| `sort` | string: hot / latest | no | `hot` | Result order. |
| `cursor` | string | no |  | Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call. |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Post](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/post/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Post ID on the platform. |
| `url` | string | Link to the post. |
| `type` | string | What kind of post it is. |
| `title` | string \| null | Title, where the platform has one (videos, notes, articles). |
| `text` | string | Caption, body or description as plain text; articles come as Markdown. |
| `lang` | string \| null | Language code, as reported or detected. |
| `published_at` | string | When it was published, ISO 8601 in UTC. |
| `author` | AccountRef | Who posted it. |
| `metrics` | Metrics | Counts at fetch time; a count the platform hides is null. |
| `images` | string[] \| null | Image URLs for image posts and notes. |
| `hashtags` | string[] \| null | Hashtags or topics, without the # sign. |
| `ext` | object | Platform-specific extras. Only returned with view=full. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL

```bash
curl -G "https://api.okdata.online/v1/weibo/posts/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'query=新品发布'
```

##### Python

```python
import os
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    "https://api.okdata.online/v1/weibo/posts/search",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OKDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    params={"query": "新品发布"},
    timeout=60,
)
body = resp.json()
if body["code"] != "ok":
    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")

for row in body["data"]["items"]:
    print(row["id"], row["metrics"]["likes"], row["text"][:60])
print("cost: $" + body["meta"]["billing"]["amount"])
```

##### TypeScript

```ts
const url = new URL('https://api.okdata.online/v1/weibo/posts/search');
url.searchParams.set('query', "新品发布");

const res = await fetch(url, {
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.OKDATA_API_KEY}`,
  },
});
const body = await res.json();
if (body.code !== 'ok') throw new Error(`${body.code}: ${body.message}`);

for (const row of body.data.items) {
  console.log(row.id, row.metrics.likes, row.text.slice(0, 60));
}
console.log('cost: $' + body.meta.billing.amount);
```

##### MCP

```json
{
  "name": "call",
  "arguments": {
    "endpoint": "weibo.posts.search",
    "params": {
      "query": "新品发布"
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "5098765432109876",
        "url": "https://weibo.com/1234567890/PbQ7rT2xZ",
        "type": "text",
        "title": null,
        "text": "新品今天开售，评论区抽三位送同款。",
        "lang": "zh",
        "published_at": "2026-11-02T09:30:00Z",
        "author": {
          "id": "1234567890",
          "username": null,
          "name": "轻装户外官方",
          "avatar_url": "https://cdn.example.com/avatar/trailkit.jpg",
          "followers": 532000,
          "verified": true
        },
        "metrics": {
          "views": null,
          "likes": 48200,
          "comments": 1312,
          "shares": null,
          "favorites": null,
          "reposts": 640
        },
        "images": [
          "https://wx1.sinaimg.example.com/large/abc123.jpg"
        ],

          "新品发布"
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "page": {
    "next_cursor": "eyJvIjoyMH0",
    "has_more": true
  },
  "warnings": [],

    "capability": "weibo.posts.search",
    "billing": {
      "amount": "0.002",
      "currency": "USD",
      "balance_after": "9.998"
    },
    "unavailable": {
      "metrics.views": "platform",
      "metrics.shares": "platform",
      "metrics.favorites": "platform"
    },
    "cached": false,
    "replayed": false,
    "fetched_at": "2026-11-11T08:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

#### Errors

Errors share one shape and are never charged, except a timeout, whose charge is unknown until looked up. The full table: https://okdata.online/docs/errors/

#### Questions

##### How much does the Weibo post search API cost?

One call costs $0.002 and returns one page of about 10 posts. Collecting 1,000 posts takes about 100 calls, $0.20 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

##### How do I get the next page?

Pass page.next_cursor from the response back as the cursor parameter. When page.has_more is false there is nothing left. Every page is its own call at $0.002.

##### Do I need a Weibo account, cookies or a QR login?

No. You send only your okdata API key. The data is public data from Weibo; nothing is fetched with your own Weibo account.

##### Am I charged when a call fails?

No. Every error response says charged: false, except a timeout, which says charged: null until the outcome is known. Resend with the same Idempotency-Key and you are never charged twice.

##### What if Weibo does not show a field?

The field is null, and meta.unavailable names it with the reason: platform (the platform never shows it) or capability (we cannot fetch it yet).

#### More Weibo endpoints

- [Weibo hot search](https://okdata.online/apis/weibo/trends/list/): $0.002 per call · about 50 board entries per page
- [Weibo account profile](https://okdata.online/apis/weibo/users/get/): $0.002 per call

### Weibo hot search API

> The Weibo hot search list with rank and heat.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/weibo/trends/list/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/weibo/trends/list`
- **ID**: `weibo.trends.list`
- **Price**: $0.002 per call · about 50 board entries per page
- **Returns**: a page of about 50 board entries (`data.items`, Trend objects)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Trend research

#### Price

One call costs $0.002 and returns one page of about 50 board entries. Collecting 1,000 board entries takes about 20 calls, $0.04 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | string | no |  | Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call. |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Trend](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/trend/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `rank` | integer | Position on the board, 1 is the top. |
| `name` | string | The topic or search term. |
| `heat` | number \| null | The heat score the platform shows; scales differ by platform. |
| `url` | string \| null | Link to the topic page, if there is one. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL

```bash
curl "https://api.okdata.online/v1/weibo/trends/list" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY"
```

##### Python

```python
import os
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    "https://api.okdata.online/v1/weibo/trends/list",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OKDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    params={},
    timeout=60,
)
body = resp.json()
if body["code"] != "ok":
    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")

for row in body["data"]["items"]:
    print(row["rank"], row["name"], row["heat"])
print("cost: $" + body["meta"]["billing"]["amount"])
```

##### TypeScript

```ts

const res = await fetch(url, {
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.OKDATA_API_KEY}`,
  },
});
const body = await res.json();
if (body.code !== 'ok') throw new Error(`${body.code}: ${body.message}`);

for (const row of body.data.items) {
  console.log(row.rank, row.name, row.heat);
}
console.log('cost: $' + body.meta.billing.amount);
```

```json
  }
```

### Weibo account profile API

> Followers, post count, verification and bio of an account.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/weibo/users/get/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/weibo/users/get`
- **ID**: `weibo.users.get`
- **Price**: $0.002 per call
- **Returns**: one Account object (`data.item`)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Competitor monitoring, Creator discovery

#### Price

One call costs $0.002 and returns one account. 1,000 lookups cost $2.00. Failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  | The account ID (sec_uid / user id as the platform uses it). (e.g. `1234567890`) |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Account](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/account/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Account ID on the platform. |
| `url` | string | Profile link. |
| `username` | string \| null | Handle, where the platform has one. |
| `name` | string | Display name. |
| `bio` | string \| null | Profile bio. |
| `avatar_url` | string \| null | Avatar image URL. |
| `verified` | boolean \| null | Whether the platform shows a verification badge. |
| `followers` | integer \| null | Followers. |
| `following` | integer \| null | Accounts it follows. |
| `posts` | integer \| null | Posts, videos, notes or articles published. |
| `likes` | integer \| null | Total likes received, where the platform shows it. |
| `ext` | object | Platform-specific extras. Only returned with view=full. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL

```bash
curl -G "https://api.okdata.online/v1/weibo/users/get" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'id=1234567890'
```

##### Python

```python
import os
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    "https://api.okdata.online/v1/weibo/users/get",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OKDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    params={"id": "1234567890"},
    timeout=60,
)
body = resp.json()
if body["code"] != "ok":
    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")

row = body["data"]["item"]
print(row["name"], row["followers"])
print("cost: $" + body["meta"]["billing"]["amount"])
```

```ts

    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.OKDATA_API_KEY}`,
  },
```

### TikTok video search API

> Videos matching keywords worldwide, with plays, likes, comments and shares.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/tiktok/videos/search/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/tiktok/videos/search`
- **ID**: `tiktok.videos.search`
- **Price**: $0.002 per call · about 30 videos per page
- **Returns**: a page of about 30 videos (`data.items`, Post objects)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Content research, Trend research

#### Price

One call costs $0.002 and returns one page of about 30 videos. Collecting 1,000 videos takes about 34 calls, $0.068 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  | Keywords, as a person would type them into the platform search box. (e.g. `ai agents`) |
| `sort` | string: relevance / latest / most_liked | no | `relevance` | Result order. |
| `cursor` | string | no |  | Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call. |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Post](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/post/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Post ID on the platform. |
| `url` | string | Link to the post. |
| `type` | string | What kind of post it is. |
| `title` | string \| null | Title, where the platform has one (videos, notes, articles). |
| `text` | string | Caption, body or description as plain text; articles come as Markdown. |
| `lang` | string \| null | Language code, as reported or detected. |
| `published_at` | string | When it was published, ISO 8601 in UTC. |
| `author` | AccountRef | Who posted it. |
| `metrics` | Metrics | Counts at fetch time; a count the platform hides is null. |
| `images` | string[] \| null | Image URLs for image posts and notes. |
| `hashtags` | string[] \| null | Hashtags or topics, without the # sign. |
| `ext` | object | Platform-specific extras. Only returned with view=full. |

### TikTok video detail API

> One video by ID or link.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/tiktok/videos/get/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/tiktok/videos/get`
- **ID**: `tiktok.videos.get`
- **Price**: $0.002 per call
- **Returns**: one Post object (`data.item`)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Competitor monitoring

#### Price

One call costs $0.002 and returns one post. 1,000 lookups cost $2.00. Failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | no |  | The video ID. Give id or url. (e.g. `7305085486984858894`) |
| `url` | string | no |  | A share link or page URL; the ID is read from it. (e.g. `https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/7305085486984858894`) |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

Give id or url; one of the two is enough. 
cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Post](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/post/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Post ID on the platform. |
| `url` | string | Link to the post. |
| `type` | string | What kind of post it is. |
| `title` | string \| null | Title, where the platform has one (videos, notes, articles). |
| `text` | string | Caption, body or description as plain text; articles come as Markdown. |
| `lang` | string \| null | Language code, as reported or detected. |
| `published_at` | string | When it was published, ISO 8601 in UTC. |
| `author` | AccountRef | Who posted it. |
| `metrics` | Metrics | Counts at fetch time; a count the platform hides is null. |
| `images` | string[] \| null | Image URLs for image posts and notes. |
| `hashtags` | string[] \| null | Hashtags or topics, without the # sign. |
| `ext` | object | Platform-specific extras. Only returned with view=full. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL

```bash
curl -G "https://api.okdata.online/v1/tiktok/videos/get" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'id=7305085486984858894'
```

##### Python

```python
import os
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    "https://api.okdata.online/v1/tiktok/videos/get",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OKDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    params={"id": "7305085486984858894"},
    timeout=60,
)
body = resp.json()
if body["code"] != "ok":
    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")

row = body["data"]["item"]
print(row["id"], row["metrics"]["likes"], row["text"][:60])
print("cost: $" + body["meta"]["billing"]["amount"])
```

##### TypeScript

```ts
const url = new URL('https://api.okdata.online/v1/tiktok/videos/get');
url.searchParams.set('id', "7305085486984858894");

const res = await fetch(url, {
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.OKDATA_API_KEY}`,
  },
});
const body = await res.json();
if (body.code !== 'ok') throw new Error(`${body.code}: ${body.message}`);

const row = body.data.item;
console.log(row.id, row.metrics.likes, row.text.slice(0, 60));
console.log('cost: $' + body.meta.billing.amount);
```

##### MCP

```json
{
  "name": "call",
  "arguments": {
    "endpoint": "tiktok.videos.get",
    "params": {
      "id": "7305085486984858894"
    }
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "code": "ok",
  "request_id": "0f6c2a8e-4b1d-4e0a-9a51-3c7d2b9e1f20",
  "data": {
    "item": {
      "id": "7305085486984858894",
      "url": "https://www.tiktok.com/@trailkit/video/7305085486984858894",
      "type": "video",
      "title": null,
      "text": "Everything I packed for two nights in the hills #camping #gear",
      "lang": "en",
      "published_at": "2026-11-02T09:30:00Z",
      "author": {
        "id": "6812345678901234567",
        "username": "trailkit",
        "name": "Trail Kit",
        "avatar_url": "https://cdn.example.com/avatar/trailkit.jpg",
        "followers": 182300,
        "verified": true
      },
      "metrics": {
        "views": 1250000,
        "likes": 48200,
        "comments": 1312,
        "shares": 2210,
        "favorites": 9650,
        "reposts": null
      },
      "images": null,
      "hashtags": [
        "camping",
        "gear"
      ]
    }
  },
  "warnings": [],
  "meta": {
    "capability": "tiktok.videos.get",
    "billing": {
      "amount": "0.002",
      "currency": "USD",
      "balance_after": "9.998"
    },
    "unavailable": {
      "metrics.reposts": "platform"
    },
    "cached": false,
    "replayed": false,
    "fetched_at": "2026-11-11T08:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

#### Errors

Errors share one shape and are never charged, except a timeout, whose charge is unknown until looked up. The full table: https://okdata.online/docs/errors/

#### Questions

##### How much does the TikTok video detail API cost?

One call costs $0.002 and returns one post. 1,000 lookups cost $2.00. Failed calls are not charged.

##### Can I pass a share link instead of an ID?

Yes. Put the link in url and okdata reads the ID from it. Short share links work too.

##### Do I need a TikTok account, cookies or a QR login?

No. You send only your okdata API key. The data is public data from TikTok; nothing is fetched with your own TikTok account.

##### Am I charged when a call fails?

No. Every error response says charged: false, except a timeout, which says charged: null until the outcome is known. Resend with the same Idempotency-Key and you are never charged twice.

##### What if TikTok does not show a field?

The field is null, and meta.unavailable names it with the reason: platform (the platform never shows it) or capability (we cannot fetch it yet).

#### More TikTok endpoints

- [TikTok video search](https://okdata.online/apis/tiktok/videos/search/): $0.002 per call · about 30 videos per page
- [TikTok video comments](https://okdata.online/apis/tiktok/videos/comments/list/): $0.002 per call · about 50 comments per page
- [TikTok account profile](https://okdata.online/apis/tiktok/users/get/): $0.002 per call

### TikTok video comments API

> Comments on a video with likes and reply counts.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/tiktok/videos/comments/list/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/tiktok/videos/comments/list`
- **ID**: `tiktok.videos.comments.list`
- **Price**: $0.002 per call · about 50 comments per page
- **Returns**: a page of about 50 comments (`data.items`, Comment objects)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Word of mouth

#### Price

One call costs $0.002 and returns one page of about 50 comments. Collecting 1,000 comments takes about 20 calls, $0.04 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  | The video ID. Give id or url. (e.g. `7305085486984858894`) |
| `cursor` | string | no |  | Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call. |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Comment](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/comment/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Comment ID. |
| `post_id` | string | ID of the post it is under. |
| `parent_id` | string \| null | The comment it replies to; null for top-level comments. |
| `text` | string | Comment text. |
| `published_at` | string | When it was posted, ISO 8601 in UTC. |
| `author` | AccountRef | Who wrote it. |
| `likes` | integer \| null | Likes on the comment. |
| `replies` | integer \| null | Replies under it. |
| `ip_location` | string \| null | Region label the platform shows next to the comment, if any. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL

```bash
curl -G "https://api.okdata.online/v1/tiktok/videos/comments/list" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'id=7305085486984858894'
```

##### Python

```python
import os
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    "https://api.okdata.online/v1/tiktok/videos/comments/list",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OKDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    params={"id": "7305085486984858894"},
    timeout=60,
)
body = resp.json()
if body["code"] != "ok":
    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")

for row in body["data"]["items"]:
    print(row["likes"], row["text"])
print("cost: $" + body["meta"]["billing"]["amount"])
```

##### TypeScript

```ts
const url = new URL('https://api.okdata.online/v1/tiktok/videos/comments/list');
url.searchParams.set('id', "7305085486984858894");

const res = await fetch(url, {
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.OKDATA_API_KEY}`,
  },
});
const body = await res.json();
if (body.code !== 'ok') throw new Error(`${body.code}: ${body.message}`);

for (const row of body.data.items) {
  console.log(row.likes, row.text);
}
console.log('cost: $' + body.meta.billing.amount);
```

##### MCP

```json
{
  "name": "call",
  "arguments": {
    "endpoint": "tiktok.videos.comments.list",
    "params": {
      "id": "7305085486984858894"
    }
  }
}
```

#### Errors

Errors share one shape and are never charged, except a timeout, whose charge is unknown until looked up. The full table: https://okdata.online/docs/errors/

#### Questions

##### How much does the TikTok video comments API cost?

One call costs $0.002 and returns one page of about 50 comments. Collecting 1,000 comments takes about 20 calls, $0.04 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

##### How do I get the next page?

Pass page.next_cursor from the response back as the cursor parameter. When page.has_more is false there is nothing left. Every page is its own call at $0.002.

##### Do I need a TikTok account, cookies or a QR login?

No. You send only your okdata API key. The data is public data from TikTok; nothing is fetched with your own TikTok account.

##### Am I charged when a call fails?

No. Every error response says charged: false, except a timeout, which says charged: null until the outcome is known. Resend with the same Idempotency-Key and you are never charged twice.

##### What if TikTok does not show a field?

The field is null, and meta.unavailable names it with the reason: platform (the platform never shows it) or capability (we cannot fetch it yet).

- [TikTok video search](https://okdata.online/apis/tiktok/videos/search/): $0.002 per call · about 30 videos per page
- [TikTok video detail](https://okdata.online/apis/tiktok/videos/get/): $0.002 per call
- [TikTok account profile](https://okdata.online/apis/tiktok/users/get/): $0.002 per call

### TikTok account profile API

> Followers, likes, video count and bio of an account.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/tiktok/users/get/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/tiktok/users/get`
- **ID**: `tiktok.users.get`
- **Price**: $0.002 per call
- **Returns**: one Account object (`data.item`)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Creator discovery, Competitor monitoring

#### Price

One call costs $0.002 and returns one account. 1,000 lookups cost $2.00. Failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | string | yes |  | The handle, with or without @. (e.g. `khaby.lame`) |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Account](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/account/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Account ID on the platform. |
| `url` | string | Profile link. |
| `username` | string \| null | Handle, where the platform has one. |
| `name` | string | Display name. |
| `bio` | string \| null | Profile bio. |
| `avatar_url` | string \| null | Avatar image URL. |
| `verified` | boolean \| null | Whether the platform shows a verification badge. |
| `followers` | integer \| null | Followers. |
| `following` | integer \| null | Accounts it follows. |
| `posts` | integer \| null | Posts, videos, notes or articles published. |
| `likes` | integer \| null | Total likes received, where the platform shows it. |
| `ext` | object | Platform-specific extras. Only returned with view=full. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL

```bash
curl -G "https://api.okdata.online/v1/tiktok/users/get" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'username=khaby.lame'
```

```python
    timeout=60,
)

    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")
```

### X post detail API

> One post by ID or link: text, media, views, likes, reposts and replies.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/x/posts/get/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/x/posts/get`
- **ID**: `x.posts.get`
- **Price**: $0.001 per call
- **Returns**: one Post object (`data.item`)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Competitor monitoring, Content research

#### Price

One call costs $0.001 and returns one post. 1,000 lookups cost $1.00. Failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | no |  | The post ID. Give id or url. (e.g. `1850000000000000000`) |
| `url` | string | no |  | A share link or page URL; the ID is read from it. (e.g. `https://x.com/user/status/1850000000000000000`) |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

Give id or url; one of the two is enough. 
cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Post](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/post/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Post ID on the platform. |
| `url` | string | Link to the post. |
| `type` | string | What kind of post it is. |
| `title` | string \| null | Title, where the platform has one (videos, notes, articles). |
| `text` | string | Caption, body or description as plain text; articles come as Markdown. |
| `lang` | string \| null | Language code, as reported or detected. |
| `published_at` | string | When it was published, ISO 8601 in UTC. |
| `author` | AccountRef | Who posted it. |
| `metrics` | Metrics | Counts at fetch time; a count the platform hides is null. |
| `images` | string[] \| null | Image URLs for image posts and notes. |
| `hashtags` | string[] \| null | Hashtags or topics, without the # sign. |
| `ext` | object | Platform-specific extras. Only returned with view=full. |

No. You send only your okdata API key. The data is public data from X (Twitter); nothing is fetched with your own X (Twitter) account.

##### Am I charged when a call fails?

No. Every error response says charged: false, except a timeout, which says charged: null until the outcome is known. Resend with the same Idempotency-Key and you are never charged twice.

##### What if X (Twitter) does not show a field?

The field is null, and meta.unavailable names it with the reason: platform (the platform never shows it) or capability (we cannot fetch it yet).

#### More X (Twitter) endpoints

- [X post search](https://okdata.online/apis/x/posts/search/): $0.006 per call · about 20 posts per page
- [X account profile](https://okdata.online/apis/x/users/get/): $0.001 per call
- [X account posts](https://okdata.online/apis/x/users/posts/list/): $0.006 per call · about 20 posts per page
- [X trending topics](https://okdata.online/apis/x/trends/list/): $0.009 per call · about 30 board entries per page

### X post search API

> Posts matching a query (X search operators work), latest or top.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/x/posts/search/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/x/posts/search`
- **ID**: `x.posts.search`
- **Price**: $0.006 per call · about 20 posts per page
- **Returns**: a page of about 20 posts (`data.items`, Post objects)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Word of mouth, Trend research

#### Price

One call costs $0.006 and returns one page of about 20 posts. Collecting 1,000 posts takes about 50 calls, $0.30 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  | Keywords, as a person would type them into the platform search box. (e.g. `"claude code" lang:zh`) |
| `sort` | string: latest / top | no | `latest` | Result order. |
| `cursor` | string | no |  | Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call. |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Post](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/post/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Post ID on the platform. |
| `url` | string | Link to the post. |
| `type` | string | What kind of post it is. |
| `title` | string \| null | Title, where the platform has one (videos, notes, articles). |
| `text` | string | Caption, body or description as plain text; articles come as Markdown. |
| `lang` | string \| null | Language code, as reported or detected. |
| `published_at` | string | When it was published, ISO 8601 in UTC. |
| `author` | AccountRef | Who posted it. |
| `metrics` | Metrics | Counts at fetch time; a count the platform hides is null. |
| `images` | string[] \| null | Image URLs for image posts and notes. |
| `hashtags` | string[] \| null | Hashtags or topics, without the # sign. |
| `ext` | object | Platform-specific extras. Only returned with view=full. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL

```bash
curl -G "https://api.okdata.online/v1/x/posts/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'query="claude code" lang:zh'
```

##### Python

```python
import os
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    "https://api.okdata.online/v1/x/posts/search",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OKDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    params={"query": "\"claude code\" lang:zh"},
    timeout=60,
)
body = resp.json()
if body["code"] != "ok":
    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")

for row in body["data"]["items"]:
    print(row["id"], row["metrics"]["likes"], row["text"][:60])
print("cost: $" + body["meta"]["billing"]["amount"])
```

##### TypeScript

```ts
const url = new URL('https://api.okdata.online/v1/x/posts/search');
url.searchParams.set('query', "\"claude code\" lang:zh");

const res = await fetch(url, {
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.OKDATA_API_KEY}`,
  },
});
const body = await res.json();
if (body.code !== 'ok') throw new Error(`${body.code}: ${body.message}`);

for (const row of body.data.items) {
  console.log(row.id, row.metrics.likes, row.text.slice(0, 60));
}
console.log('cost: $' + body.meta.billing.amount);
```

##### MCP

```json
{
  "name": "call",
  "arguments": {
    "endpoint": "x.posts.search",
    "params": {
      "query": "\"claude code\" lang:zh"
    }
  }
}
```

Or ask an agent that has the MCP server connected:

> Use X post search and list the five posts with the most likes, with links.

```json
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "1856012345678901234",
        "url": "https://x.com/trailkit/status/1856012345678901234",
        "type": "text",
        "title": null,
        "text": "Shipped the lighter tent today. 1.1 kg packed, same footprint.",
        "lang": "en",
        "published_at": "2026-11-02T09:30:00Z",

          "id": "1450012345678901248",
          "username": "trailkit",
          "name": "Trail Kit",
          "avatar_url": "https://cdn.example.com/avatar/trailkit.jpg",
          "followers": 18230,
          "verified": true
        },
        "metrics": {
          "views": 1250000,
          "likes": 48200,
          "comments": 1312,
          "shares": null,
          "favorites": 9650,
          "reposts": 640

        "images": null,
        "hashtags": null
      }
    ]

    "has_more": true
  },
  "warnings": [],
  "meta": {
    "capability": "x.posts.search",
    "billing": {
      "amount": "0.006",
      "currency": "USD",
      "balance_after": "9.994"
    },
    "unavailable": {
      "metrics.shares": "platform"
    },
    "cached": false,
    "replayed": false,
    "fetched_at": "2026-11-11T08:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

#### Errors

Errors share one shape and are never charged, except a timeout, whose charge is unknown until looked up. The full table: https://okdata.online/docs/errors/

#### Questions

##### How much does the X post search API cost?

One call costs $0.006 and returns one page of about 20 posts. Collecting 1,000 posts takes about 50 calls, $0.30 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

##### How do I get the next page?

Pass page.next_cursor from the response back as the cursor parameter. When page.has_more is false there is nothing left. Every page is its own call at $0.006.

##### Do I need a X (Twitter) account, cookies or a QR login?

No. You send only your okdata API key. The data is public data from X (Twitter); nothing is fetched with your own X (Twitter) account.

##### Am I charged when a call fails?

No. Every error response says charged: false, except a timeout, which says charged: null until the outcome is known. Resend with the same Idempotency-Key and you are never charged twice.

##### What if X (Twitter) does not show a field?

The field is null, and meta.unavailable names it with the reason: platform (the platform never shows it) or capability (we cannot fetch it yet).

#### More X (Twitter) endpoints

- [X post detail](https://okdata.online/apis/x/posts/get/): $0.001 per call
- [X account profile](https://okdata.online/apis/x/users/get/): $0.001 per call
- [X account posts](https://okdata.online/apis/x/users/posts/list/): $0.006 per call · about 20 posts per page
- [X trending topics](https://okdata.online/apis/x/trends/list/): $0.009 per call · about 30 board entries per page

### X account profile API

> Followers, following, post count, bio and verification of an account.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/x/users/get/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/x/users/get`
- **ID**: `x.users.get`
- **Price**: $0.001 per call
- **Returns**: one Account object (`data.item`)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Creator discovery, Competitor monitoring

#### Price

One call costs $0.001 and returns one account. 1,000 lookups cost $1.00. Failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | string | yes |  | The handle, with or without @. (e.g. `openai`) |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Account](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/account/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Account ID on the platform. |
| `url` | string | Profile link. |
| `username` | string \| null | Handle, where the platform has one. |
| `name` | string | Display name. |
| `bio` | string \| null | Profile bio. |
| `avatar_url` | string \| null | Avatar image URL. |
| `verified` | boolean \| null | Whether the platform shows a verification badge. |
| `followers` | integer \| null | Followers. |
| `following` | integer \| null | Accounts it follows. |
| `posts` | integer \| null | Posts, videos, notes or articles published. |
| `likes` | integer \| null | Total likes received, where the platform shows it. |
| `ext` | object | Platform-specific extras. Only returned with view=full. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL

```bash
curl -G "https://api.okdata.online/v1/x/users/get" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'username=openai'
```

##### Python

```python
import os
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    "https://api.okdata.online/v1/x/users/get",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OKDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    params={"username": "openai"},
    timeout=60,
)
body = resp.json()
if body["code"] != "ok":
    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")

row = body["data"]["item"]
print(row["name"], row["followers"])
print("cost: $" + body["meta"]["billing"]["amount"])
```

##### TypeScript

```ts
const url = new URL('https://api.okdata.online/v1/x/users/get');
url.searchParams.set('username', "openai");

const res = await fetch(url, {
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.OKDATA_API_KEY}`,
  },
});
const body = await res.json();
if (body.code !== 'ok') throw new Error(`${body.code}: ${body.message}`);

const row = body.data.item;
console.log(row.name, row.followers);
console.log('cost: $' + body.meta.billing.amount);
```

##### MCP

```json
{
  "name": "call",
  "arguments": {
    "endpoint": "x.users.get",
    "params": {
      "username": "openai"
    }
  }
}
```

### X account posts API

> An account's posts, newest first.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/x/users/posts/list/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/x/users/posts/list`
- **ID**: `x.users.posts.list`
- **Price**: $0.006 per call · about 20 posts per page
- **Returns**: a page of about 20 posts (`data.items`, Post objects)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Competitor monitoring

#### Price

One call costs $0.006 and returns one page of about 20 posts. Collecting 1,000 posts takes about 50 calls, $0.30 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

| `type` | string | What kind of post it is. |

### X trending topics API

> Trending topics worldwide or for one country.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/x/trends/list/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/x/trends/list`
- **ID**: `x.trends.list`
- **Price**: $0.009 per call · about 30 board entries per page
- **Returns**: a page of about 30 board entries (`data.items`, Trend objects)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Trend research

#### Price

One call costs $0.009 and returns one page of about 30 board entries. Collecting 1,000 board entries takes about 34 calls, $0.306 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `country` | string | no |  | ISO country code; worldwide when omitted. (e.g. `US`) |
| `cursor` | string | no |  | Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call. |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Trend](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/trend/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `rank` | integer | Position on the board, 1 is the top. |
| `name` | string | The topic or search term. |
| `heat` | number \| null | The heat score the platform shows; scales differ by platform. |
| `url` | string \| null | Link to the topic page, if there is one. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL

```bash
curl "https://api.okdata.online/v1/x/trends/list" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY"
```

##### Python

```python
import os
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    "https://api.okdata.online/v1/x/trends/list",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OKDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    params={},
    timeout=60,
)
body = resp.json()
if body["code"] != "ok":
    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")

for row in body["data"]["items"]:
    print(row["rank"], row["name"], row["heat"])
print("cost: $" + body["meta"]["billing"]["amount"])
```

```json
}
```

#### Errors

Errors share one shape and are never charged, except a timeout, whose charge is unknown until looked up. The full table: https://okdata.online/docs/errors/

#### Questions

##### How much does the X trending topics API cost?

One call costs $0.009 and returns one page of about 30 board entries. Collecting 1,000 board entries takes about 34 calls, $0.306 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

##### How do I get the next page?

Pass page.next_cursor from the response back as the cursor parameter. When page.has_more is false there is nothing left. Every page is its own call at $0.009.

##### Do I need a X (Twitter) account, cookies or a QR login?

No. You send only your okdata API key. The data is public data from X (Twitter); nothing is fetched with your own X (Twitter) account.

##### Am I charged when a call fails?

No. Every error response says charged: false, except a timeout, which says charged: null until the outcome is known. Resend with the same Idempotency-Key and you are never charged twice.

##### What if X (Twitter) does not show a field?

The field is null, and meta.unavailable names it with the reason: platform (the platform never shows it) or capability (we cannot fetch it yet).

#### More X (Twitter) endpoints

- [X post detail](https://okdata.online/apis/x/posts/get/): $0.001 per call
- [X post search](https://okdata.online/apis/x/posts/search/): $0.006 per call · about 20 posts per page
- [X account profile](https://okdata.online/apis/x/users/get/): $0.001 per call
- [X account posts](https://okdata.online/apis/x/users/posts/list/): $0.006 per call · about 20 posts per page

### YouTube video search API

> Videos matching keywords with views, length and channel.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/youtube/videos/search/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/youtube/videos/search`
- **ID**: `youtube.videos.search`
- **Price**: $0.004 per call · about 20 videos per page
- **Returns**: a page of about 20 videos (`data.items`, Post objects)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Content research

#### Price

One call costs $0.004 and returns one page of about 20 videos. Collecting 1,000 videos takes about 50 calls, $0.20 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  | Keywords, as a person would type them into the platform search box. (e.g. `claude code tutorial`) |
| `sort` | string: relevance / latest / most_viewed | no | `relevance` | Result order. |
| `cursor` | string | no |  | Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call. |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Post](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/post/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Post ID on the platform. |
| `url` | string | Link to the post. |
| `type` | string | What kind of post it is. |
| `title` | string \| null | Title, where the platform has one (videos, notes, articles). |
| `text` | string | Caption, body or description as plain text; articles come as Markdown. |
| `lang` | string \| null | Language code, as reported or detected. |
| `published_at` | string | When it was published, ISO 8601 in UTC. |
| `author` | AccountRef | Who posted it. |
| `metrics` | Metrics | Counts at fetch time; a count the platform hides is null. |
| `images` | string[] \| null | Image URLs for image posts and notes. |
| `hashtags` | string[] \| null | Hashtags or topics, without the # sign. |
| `ext` | object | Platform-specific extras. Only returned with view=full. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL

```bash
curl -G "https://api.okdata.online/v1/youtube/videos/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'query=claude code tutorial'
```

##### Python

```python
import os
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    "https://api.okdata.online/v1/youtube/videos/search",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OKDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    params={"query": "claude code tutorial"},
    timeout=60,
)
body = resp.json()
if body["code"] != "ok":
    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")

for row in body["data"]["items"]:
    print(row["id"], row["metrics"]["likes"], row["text"][:60])
print("cost: $" + body["meta"]["billing"]["amount"])
```

##### TypeScript

```ts
const url = new URL('https://api.okdata.online/v1/youtube/videos/search');
url.searchParams.set('query', "claude code tutorial");

const res = await fetch(url, {
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.OKDATA_API_KEY}`,
  },
});
const body = await res.json();
if (body.code !== 'ok') throw new Error(`${body.code}: ${body.message}`);

for (const row of body.data.items) {
  console.log(row.id, row.metrics.likes, row.text.slice(0, 60));
}
console.log('cost: $' + body.meta.billing.amount);
```

##### MCP

```json
{
  "name": "call",
  "arguments": {
    "endpoint": "youtube.videos.search",
    "params": {
      "query": "claude code tutorial"
    }
  }
}
```

### YouTube video detail API

> One video by ID or link: title, description, views, likes and channel.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/youtube/videos/get/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/youtube/videos/get`
- **ID**: `youtube.videos.get`
- **Price**: $0.004 per call
- **Returns**: one Post object (`data.item`)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Competitor monitoring

#### Price

One call costs $0.004 and returns one post. 1,000 lookups cost $4.00. Failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | no |  | The video ID. Give id or url. (e.g. `dQw4w9WgXcQ`) |
| `url` | string | no |  | A share link or page URL; the ID is read from it. (e.g. `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ`) |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

Give id or url; one of the two is enough. 
cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Post](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/post/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Post ID on the platform. |
| `url` | string | Link to the post. |
| `type` | string | What kind of post it is. |
| `title` | string \| null | Title, where the platform has one (videos, notes, articles). |
| `text` | string | Caption, body or description as plain text; articles come as Markdown. |
| `lang` | string \| null | Language code, as reported or detected. |
| `published_at` | string | When it was published, ISO 8601 in UTC. |
| `author` | AccountRef | Who posted it. |
| `metrics` | Metrics | Counts at fetch time; a count the platform hides is null. |
| `images` | string[] \| null | Image URLs for image posts and notes. |
| `hashtags` | string[] \| null | Hashtags or topics, without the # sign. |
| `ext` | object | Platform-specific extras. Only returned with view=full. |

##### cURL

```bash
curl -G "https://api.okdata.online/v1/youtube/videos/get" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKDATA_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'id=dQw4w9WgXcQ'
```

##### Python

```python
import os
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    "https://api.okdata.online/v1/youtube/videos/get",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OKDATA_API_KEY']}"},
    params={"id": "dQw4w9WgXcQ"},
    timeout=60,
)
body = resp.json()
if body["code"] != "ok":
    raise RuntimeError(f"{body['code']}: {body['message']} (charged: {body['charged']})")

row = body["data"]["item"]
print(row["id"], row["metrics"]["likes"], row["text"][:60])
print("cost: $" + body["meta"]["billing"]["amount"])
```

##### TypeScript

```ts

  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.OKDATA_API_KEY}`,
  },
});

const row = body.data.item;
console.log(row.id, row.metrics.likes, row.text.slice(0, 60));
console.log('cost: $' + body.meta.billing.amount);
```

#### Questions

One call costs $0.004 and returns one post. 1,000 lookups cost $4.00. Failed calls are not charged.

##### Can I pass a share link instead of an ID?

- [YouTube video transcript](https://okdata.online/apis/youtube/videos/transcript/get/): $0.004 per call

### YouTube video comments API

> Comments on a video, top or newest first.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/youtube/videos/comments/list/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/youtube/videos/comments/list`
- **ID**: `youtube.videos.comments.list`
- **Price**: $0.004 per call · about 20 comments per page
- **Returns**: a page of about 20 comments (`data.items`, Comment objects)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Word of mouth

#### Price

One call costs $0.004 and returns one page of about 20 comments. Collecting 1,000 comments takes about 50 calls, $0.20 in total. Each page is a separate call; failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  | The video ID. Give id or url. (e.g. `dQw4w9WgXcQ`) |
| `sort` | string: top / latest | no | `top` | Result order. |
| `cursor` | string | no |  | Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call. |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Comment](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/comment/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Comment ID. |
| `post_id` | string | ID of the post it is under. |
| `parent_id` | string \| null | The comment it replies to; null for top-level comments. |
| `text` | string | Comment text. |
| `published_at` | string | When it was posted, ISO 8601 in UTC. |
| `author` | AccountRef | Who wrote it. |
| `likes` | integer \| null | Likes on the comment. |
| `replies` | integer \| null | Replies under it. |
| `ip_location` | string \| null | Region label the platform shows next to the comment, if any. |

### YouTube video transcript API

> The transcript of a video with timestamps, in the original or a chosen language.

Canonical page: https://okdata.online/apis/youtube/videos/transcript/get/

- **Endpoint**: `GET /v1/youtube/videos/transcript/get`
- **ID**: `youtube.videos.transcript.get`
- **Price**: $0.004 per call
- **Returns**: one Transcript object (`data.item`)
- **Status**: beta
- **Good for**: Transcripts, Content research

#### Price

One call costs $0.004 and returns one transcript. 1,000 lookups cost $4.00. Failed calls are not charged.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  | The video ID. Give id or url. (e.g. `dQw4w9WgXcQ`) |
| `lang` | string | no |  | Preferred transcript language. (e.g. `en`) |
| `view` | string: compact / standard / full | no | `standard` | How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext. |
| `fields` | string | no |  | Comma-separated fields to keep, to save tokens. |

cursor, view and fields work as described in [Requests](https://okdata.online/docs/requests/).

#### Returned fields

Each item is a [Transcript](https://okdata.online/docs/objects/transcript/).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | ID of the video. |
| `lang` | string | Language of this transcript. |
| `segments` | Segment[] | Timed segments in order. |
| `text` | string | All segments joined as plain text. |

#### Request examples

##### cURL


##### TypeScript

```ts
const url = new URL('https://api.okdata.online/v1/youtube/videos/transcript/get');
url.searchParams.set('id', "dQw4w9WgXcQ");

const res = await fetch(url, {
  headers: {

});
const body = await res.json();
if (body.code !== 'ok') throw new Error(`${body.code}: ${body.message}`);

const row = body.data.item;
console.log(row.text.slice(0, 200));
console.log('cost: $' + body.meta.billing.amount);
```

##### MCP

```json
{
  "name": "call",
  "arguments": {
    "endpoint": "youtube.videos.transcript.get",
    "params": {
      "id": "dQw4w9WgXcQ"
    }
  }
}
```

Or ask an agent that has the MCP server connected:

> Use YouTube video transcript and summarise what the video says in five bullet points.

#### Response example

```json
{
  "code": "ok",
  "request_id": "0f6c2a8e-4b1d-4e0a-9a51-3c7d2b9e1f20",
  "data": {
    "item": {
      "video_id": "Zx3kP9vQm2A",
      "lang": "en",
      "segments": [
        {
          "start": 0,
          "end": 4.2,
          "text": "Here is what I pack for a two-night trip."
        }
      ],
      "text": "Here is what I pack for a two-night trip."
    }
  },
  "warnings": [],
  "meta": {
    "capability": "youtube.videos.transcript.get",
    "billing": {
      "amount": "0.004",
      "currency": "USD",
      "balance_after": "9.996"
    },
    "unavailable": {},
    "cached": false,
    "replayed": false,
    "fetched_at": "2026-11-11T08:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

#### Errors

Errors share one shape and are never charged, except a timeout, whose charge is unknown until looked up. The full table: https://okdata.online/docs/errors/

#### Questions

##### How much does the YouTube video transcript API cost?

One call costs $0.004 and returns one transcript. 1,000 lookups cost $4.00. Failed calls are not charged.

##### Do I need a YouTube account, cookies or a QR login?

No. You send only your okdata API key. The data is public data from YouTube; nothing is fetched with your own YouTube account.

##### Am I charged when a call fails?

No. Every error response says charged: false, except a timeout, which says charged: null until the outcome is known. Resend with the same Idempotency-Key and you are never charged twice.

##### What if YouTube does not show a field?

The field is null, and meta.unavailable names it with the reason: platform (the platform never shows it) or capability (we cannot fetch it yet).

- [YouTube video search](https://okdata.online/apis/youtube/videos/search/): $0.004 per call · about 20 videos per page
- [YouTube video detail](https://okdata.online/apis/youtube/videos/get/): $0.004 per call
- [YouTube video comments](https://okdata.online/apis/youtube/videos/comments/list/): $0.004 per call · about 20 comments per page
